intent_en: Compare the two people's accumulated wealth and shown income-tax burdens.
narration_support: Because both of us have the same job and earn about the same amount of money, our income gets taxed about the same. This bar represents my wealth, and this is my friend's wealth.
chart_support: Two labeled, axis-free vertical wealth bars: MY WEALTH is short and FRIEND'S WEALTH is much taller.
evidence_note: The narration establishes similar jobs, income, and income-tax treatment; the keyframe establishes a sharp gap in accumulated wealth.
narrative_goal: Show that two people can have the same job and similar income, yet one has far more accumulated wealth, making equal income taxation an incomplete picture.
current_model_input: Compare the two people's accumulated wealth and shown income-tax burdens.
